scope: Exact five-scene current source, selected originals, proportional derivatives and corrected-header assembled context; not release authorization.

checks.identity: I personally inspected all five selected original PNGs and all fifteen delivered WebPs, then all forty-five current rendered captures. The selected facial/design identities remain consistent within each family; this is fidelity to selected artwork, not authentication of a historical portrait or identification of a real person.
checks.age: The ride, hymnal, Quincy and hospitality designs retain their selected adult appearance; testimony retains visibly older facial lines and graying hair. No derivative introduces an age change. Exact historical age is not independently established by pixels.
checks.expression_gaze: Ride retains the intent forward/path gaze, hymnal and Quincy their downward gaze, hospitality its slight closed-mouth welcome and doorway pose, and testimony its rightward gaze, slightly open mouth and raised palm. No observed crop or re-encoding alters these expressions.
checks.atmosphere: Autumn riding, quiet book study, subdued seated reflection, warm open doorway and later-life testimony remain distinct in originals, derivatives and assembled views. The current teal page presentation does not obscure the selected artwork.
checks.environment: Framing preserves the horse/rider, closed book and hands, seated lap, doorway/hem/shoe and testimony hands/interior. At 1280, 390 and 320 CSS-pixel widths the artwork remains proportional without observed horizontal clipping. Small outputs soften fine texture without changing the composition.
checks.characters_realism: Clothing, faces, hands and poses remain faithful to each selected design across the inspected outputs; no introduced duplicate limb, face substitution or compression-driven expression change was observed. This is a bounded visual inspection, not proof of physical or historical realism.
checks.period_sources: I verified the public-safe provenance summary bindings against the retained actual historical review bytes, including the corrected four Fermi timestamps. These are source-art reviews, not retrospective canonical preflight or assembled approval. Unknown generation times remain unknown; no new period-authenticity assurance is asserted.
checks.anatomy: Selected hand/limb layouts are preserved. The ride still shows only three clear hoof endpoints; the far hind hoof is naturally occluded. Strict four-hoof visibility remains NOT_MET and is not converted to PASS by this concurrence.
checks.uniqueness: All twenty current file-byte pins were rechecked and remain the exact five originals plus three proportional derivative sizes each. Five compositions remain visually distinct. Their intended within-family similarity is not new artwork uniqueness; no generic asset exception is granted.
checks.desktop_phone: I inspected all forty-five current Chromium captures: fifteen canonical headers, fifteen artwork viewports, five 390-wide dialogs, three hubs, three focused skip links and four narrow menu/Search views. Headers are styled at all three widths; narrow controls and text fit. Unfocused skip is offscreen in sixty-nine observations and visible with focus outline in three. Search was not submitted. Actual renderer results contain thirty-one named completed journeys; scrollable long dialogs may place lower controls below the initial viewport.

limits: Current-equivalence review only. No historical canonical preflight, final release, merge, production publication or full-site PASS is claimed.
